ranked.headline: Deep learning aligns, segments and decodes spatial tissue and cellular imaging data
ranked.summary: Multiplexed imaging, spatial omics and cryo-ET now pair self-supervised and graph-based models with sparse labels and batch-effect correction.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein language model embeddings drive task-specific function predictors
ranked.summary: Recent work applies pretrained PLM embeddings to tasks from E3 ligase prediction to TCR design and lipid-binding classification.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer regulatory networks from single-cell and multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply causal discovery, graph transformers and pseudotime statistics to single-cell and multi-omics regulatory data.

ranked.headline: Learned fusion of histology, omics and cfDNA features for cancer prediction
ranked.summary: Integrative learning models now extend beyond bulk omics to cell-free DNA, spatial transcriptomics and calibrated spatial tumor simulation.

ranked.headline: Generative models separate cell states and transfer labels across single-cell datasets
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial omics datasets now demand interpretable models that separate biological factors from batch, perturbation, and cell-cycle variation.

ranked.headline: Graph networks model cross-omics feature dependencies for patient stratification
ranked.summary: Learned relational structure is increasingly used to integrate omics layers when samples are small or modalities are missing.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks fuse structure and sequence embeddings for biological prediction
ranked.summary: Multimodal graph learning now links protein structure, language-model embeddings, and drug and microbe association networks in recent work.

ranked.headline: ML models prioritize drug synergy, repurposing and toxicity from multimodal data
ranked.summary: Explainable, uncertainty-aware and multimodal models are being paired with stricter benchmarking across drug development endpoints.

ranked.headline: Machine learning tools are reshaping analysis of nanopore, genomic, and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Transformer, CNN, and LLM models are now being applied across nanopore protein sequencing, regulatory genomics, and single-cell annotation.

ranked.headline: WGS variant calling benchmarks and new SV, CNV and de novo callers refine detection
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks, local-assembly SV calling, and T2T-CHM13 reference comparisons target accuracy gaps in WGS variant detection.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict regulatory states from DNA sequence and chromatin context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend sequence-based regulatory models with chromatin structure, personalized genotypes, and synthetic training data.

ranked.headline: Ordering spatial transcriptomic snapshots in time to infer cell fate trajectories
ranked.summary: Sequential spatial transcriptomics slides enable trajectory inference of microenvironments and cell fates rather than independent snapshot analysis.

ranked.headline: Packaging sequence-analysis steps into reproducible, runnable software tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications present integrated workflows for nanopore, virome, metagenome and NGS analysis with containerized or desktop packaging.

ranked.headline: SE(3)-equivariant diffusion now generates conformational ensembles and trajectories
ranked.summary: Recent work extends SE(3)-equivariant generative models from single structures to ensembles, trajectories, antibodies, and ligand poses.

ranked.headline: Generative models now judged by synthesizability and confirmed-active benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent work tests generative design against confirmed actives, synthesis feasibility, and multi-objective activity and toxicity criteria.

ranked.headline: Interpretable learning models target microbial interactions and resistance phenotypes
ranked.summary: Microbial and genomic prediction models are now designed to expose the features driving each prediction, not only accuracy.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory and splicing activity from MPRA, knockdown and single-cell readouts
ranked.summary: Large MPRA, knockdown and single-cell multiome datasets now pair with interpretable and generative models of splicing and enhancer activity.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models predict complex binding; benchmarks expose scorer bias
ranked.summary: Independent benchmarks of AlphaFold3 and ΔΔG predictors are testing how far structure-aware complex and affinity predictions hold up.

ranked.headline: Computational tools infer kinetic and surrogate parameters for biological models
ranked.summary: Single-cell, viral, and microbial datasets are being fit with scalable inference frameworks that address identifiability and computational cost.

ranked.headline: Metagenome sequencing recovers ~60% of modeled microbiome function, even at full depth
ranked.summary: Recent work reassesses core metagenomic workflow choices, from reference databases and binning to differential abundance and rRNA depletion.

ranked.headline: Automated mining and reconciliation of public biomedical data into queryable networks
ranked.summary: Recent tools convert public transcriptomic, literature, and ontology resources into queryable networks, reanalysis pipelines, and reconciled identifiers.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for interactive, reproducible omics and metagenomic data exploration
ranked.summary: Recent releases address reproducibility and interactivity gaps across single-cell, amplicon, metabolomic, and holo-omics analyses.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks calibrate nanopore and cfDNA readouts against orthogonal reference sites
ranked.summary: Nanopore and cfDNA methods are now checked against orthogonal reference sites and combined with complementary sequencing modalities.

ranked.headline: Post-GWAS inference adapts to relatedness, pathway specificity and gene ranking
ranked.summary: Recent work addresses how GWAS-derived inference must account for related individuals, pleiotropic pathways and gene-level evidence.

ranked.headline: Faster, leaner algorithms for alignment, motif scoring, genome size and read processing
ranked.summary: Large-scale and real-time sequence analyses motivate reduced memory and runtime in alignment, motif scoring, and read-level processing.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and scaling computational phage-host assignment across viral genomes
ranked.summary: Large gut virome resources and explicit tool benchmarks now test whether host prediction holds up across contexts.

ranked.headline: Usable software tools now deliver spatial, breeding, and metabolic modeling methods
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications emphasize deployable software over new algorithmic theory across structural biology, systems biology, and breeding.

ranked.headline: Epiallele-resolved methylation meets long-read and pangenome genomics
ranked.summary: Long-read and population-scale methylome tools now resolve epiallele diversity, organellar methylation, and temperature-driven RdDM-CMT2 shifts.

ranked.headline: Automated preparation links cofolding predictions to MD of protein and lipid systems
ranked.summary: Cofolding outputs and automated structure preparation now feed directly into atomistic and coarse-grained simulation pipelines.

ranked.headline: Sparse and learned models move genetic association beyond single-locus additive effects
ranked.summary: Sparse priors and learned foundation models are reshaping how variants and genome-wide markers are modeled for prediction and interpretation.

ranked.headline: Generative and docking methods prioritize candidate molecules for experimental testing
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair generative, deep learning and ultra-large docking methods with experimental testing against specific targets.

ranked.headline: Mobile element exchange networks and plasmid tools resolve bacterial gene variation
ranked.summary: Population-scale Listeria genome networks and short-read plasmid tool benchmarks now enable finer resolution of bacterial mobile element exchange.

ranked.headline: Computational encoding of PTM chemistry and coexisting modifications in MS proteomics
ranked.summary: Deep learning and combinatorial spectral methods now encode modification chemistry and coexisting PTM isoforms directly into peptide prediction and assignment.

ranked.headline: Simulation models link dosing and resource supply to resistance and colonization
ranked.summary: Mechanistic simulations of resistance, colonization, and transmission are being used to test how dosing, resource supply, and vector traits shape outcomes.

ranked.headline: Simulations and models map sequence-encoded allosteric control in RNA systems
ranked.summary: Dynamical analyses now link sequence variation and distal sites to RNA binding and stability, from viral Tat-TAR RNA to huntingtin RNA.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models target genome annotation and transposable element typing
ranked.summary: Attention and pretrained encoders are now applied to plant genome annotation, mRNA generation and transposable element typing.

ranked.headline: ML potentials, RNA ensemble validation, and AI structure prediction teaching resources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a web tool benchmark ML-derived potentials and RNA structure ensembles against experimental density and native-like reference structures.

ranked.headline: New consistent tree methods for gene, species and network phylogenies
ranked.summary: Scalable consistent methods and confidence assessment now target gene trees, network phylogenies, and a two-million-genome SARS-CoV-2 tree.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale genomes and genotyping panels for non-model invertebrates
ranked.summary: Four November 2025 preprints add chromosome-level or de novo genomes and an amplicon genotyping panel for marine and terrestrial invertebrates.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial enzyme and metabolic capabilities across genomes
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models, machine learning, and enzyme censuses now extend microbial metabolic inference from single strains to ecosystem metagenomes.
